items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Lu Russel was on piano and myself on drums.

ctx.x: That was after the, I don't know what happened after the Orchd. But I moved down to the Cadillac Café. That's just before I went into the Lyric Theater. And Albert Nicholas was playing clarinet. Lee Collins was on trumpet and Lu Russel was on piano and myself on drums.
